_meta.note: Derived by sampling the account's own graphics. Hex values are measured from JPEG pixels, so treat them as close approximations rather than the official brand values — ask the founders for the real spec.

deepPurple.usage: Logo background gradient, darkest brand tone

cream.usage: Background of the 'Meet X' and Summer Outreach cards

DNA double helix watermark — on the lavender card template
Heartbeat/ECG line linking icons — 'Connecting Patients to Care' infographic
Large translucent 'OR' monogram — video title frames and the avatar
Layered crescent shapes with a circular photo crop — lavender template

siteMismatch.note: The website currently uses a different, more saturated palette than the Instagram graphics — gradients built from #2E1188, #5634C9, #170269, #1E0177, #FED700, #F5A623, #B89500. The account's real look is softer: cream and pale lavender grounds with amber/orange and mid-purple accents. Worth reconciling so the site and socials read as one brand.
